title: Data expertise proven in public and education settings
lead: With experience collecting and analyzing learning data at the national level, we have worked with public agencies and educational institutions on data-driven innovation.

items.title:
AI Digital Textbook
learning data hub
items.summary: We built a hub that collects AI Digital Textbook learning data using global standards, supporting national-level learning analytics indicators, curriculum standards, and learning maps.
items.did: We built a hub that collects AI Digital Textbook learning data using global standards, and we maintain the hub’s LRS.
items.result: The hub has supported national-level learning analytics indicators, curriculum standards, and learning maps.

items.title:
AI-based elementary math
class support system
items.summary: We collected learning behavior data in a gamified class support system and applied level diagnosis and item recommendation models. It is a nationwide public service with 2.4 million cumulative users.
items.did: We collected learning behavior data in a gamified class support system, then developed and applied level diagnosis and item recommendation models.
items.result: A nationwide public service with 2.4 million cumulative users. The diagnosis and recommendation models received KOLAS AI model certification.

items.title:
HRD platform
social learning as data
items.summary: We captured social learning experiences from the HRD platform’s social communities and large-scale live webinars as structured learning data.
items.did: We built the LRS for the National HRD Intelligent Open Platform and collected activity from its social communities and large-scale live webinars with xAPI.
items.result: Social learning experiences became structured learning data that can be analyzed.

items.title:
Seoul Education Platform
video mentoring analysis
items.summary: From video mentoring on the Seoul Education Platform, we collect interactions between mentors and mentees, along with emotional states and utterances, as learning data to support in-depth learning analytics.
items.did: We built the LRS for the Seoul Education Platform and collected interactions between mentors and mentees, along with emotional states and utterances, from video mentoring as learning data.
items.result: We laid a learning data foundation for in-depth analysis of video mentoring.
